newsitem.title: RUSSIA: Russian 161-day T-bill yields average 36.48 pct. [CORRECTED 15:40 GMT].
newsitem.headline: Russian 161-day T-bill yields average 36.48 pct. [CORRECTED 15:40 GMT].

text.p: The annualised average yield on a new issue of 161-day GKO Treasury bills (series 22069), maturing on July 16, was 36.48 percent at an auction on Wednesday, the central bank said.
Dealers had forecast the average yield to be between 34.95 and 36.99 percent.
The series 22064 bills, maturing on July 23, the closest maturity date to the new issue, closed at 30.80 on Tuesday.
Full details of the auction follow:
This issue is the first to be the subject to a 15 percent tax on earnings from government securities.
On February 5 the Finance Ministry will offer seven trillion roubles in a new issue of 287-day T-bills (series 22070).
It will also pay about 753.70 billion roubles in interest on the OFZ interest-bearing bond (series 24006) and about 6.48 trillion roubles in a maturing issue of six-month T-bill (series 22041).
